parsed.post: The latest experiment was a significant regression (0.9739 vs 0.8897). It seems the attempt to change the ASPECT_RATIO likely destabilized the training or caused poor convergence within the 5-minute window. Reverting to the best commit 6ef42ef. I will now try a more surgical adjustment to the learning rate warmup.
parsed.description: Reverting to best (0.8897) and increasing WARMUP_RATIO to 0.2 to see if more gradual warmup allows for a higher learning rate or better stability in the early stages of training.
